Petitioner
 Versus
 The State of Jharkhand .....
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Deepak Roshan

---------
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Vikash Anand, Advocate
 For the State : Mr. B.N. Ojha, App
 ---------
04/ 19.09.2023

The instant application has been preferred by the petitioner for grant of regular bail registered under Sections 341, 323, 354 (kha), 447 and 504 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 8 and 12 of POCSO Act.

But charge has been framed under Section 376 (3) of the IPC and Section 4 (2)
of the POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in jail custody since 27.06.2022 for no offence.
He further submits that out of total 10 witnesses only 4 witnesses have been examined, as such, he may be enlarged on bail.

3. Learned APP for the State opposed the prayer of the bail of the petitioner and submits that victim has supported the prosecution case; however, he will ensure that the trial can be concluded at the earliest.
4. Having regard to the facts of the case and the nature of allegation made against this petitioner, I am not inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
5. Further, the learned trial court is directed to conclude the trial within a period of three months.

(Deepak Roshan, J.) Pramanik/
